results.title: Run every job twice in one pass
results.evidence: 27 jobs, twice, and the register is unchanged after the second

results.title: `monitoring.stalled` at exactly three cadences
results.evidence: a monitor evaluated exactly 3 cadences ago is already reported stalled. `overdue_by` is 3 - 1 = 2 cadences and the guard is `overdue_by < cadence * (MULTIPLE - 1)`, so the boundary itself fires. Every comparable boundary in this platform is exclusive — escalation is `>` not `>=`, the acknowledge window skips on `<=`, the extension window and the tau bands the same — so this one alone reports a con

results.title: `monitoring.stalled` after the monitor was paused
results.evidence: a paused monitor is not a stalled one

results.title: `findings.overdue` does not escalate its own escalations
results.evidence: 1 escalation, and no escalation of it

results.title: `findings.unacknowledged` at exactly the acknowledge window
results.evidence: silent at 5 days, reported an hour later

results.title: One job raises during a pass
results.evidence: 27 ran, 1 failed, named in the detail with its error

results.title: Run one job by name, then the whole pass
results.evidence: one job, then the pass; 0 new finding(s) and none from the job already run

results.title: The scheduler has not run for a week
results.evidence: a week-old batch is flagged stale, not reported as a number

results.title: Delete the whole run history and run a pass
results.evidence: history cleared, and the pass is identical

results.title: Define two monitors with the same name on two models
results.evidence: one name, two models, both defined

results.title: Every label-dependent kind demands a delay
results.evidence: performance, calibration demand a delay; input_drift, score_drift do not

results.title: An ingested breach opens a breach and a finding, like any other
Bind a monitor to a model version through the API
results.evidence: no route binds a monitor to a version: `MonitorIn` has no version field, the create route never passes `model_version_id`, and seeding the defaults created 0 monitor(s) with none either. `evaluate_from_telemetry` reads that column to find the stream, so it refuses `monitor_has_no_version` for every monitor in the estate and the telemetry-driven evaluation path cannot be reached at all

results.title: The score is absent rather than zero when nothing is measurable
results.evidence: scored over 25% of the weight, and the detail says so

results.title: A heatmap of one dimension against itself
results.evidence: refused 'same_dimension', and an unknown dimension too
